answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes an anchor bet on surviving 89 epochs of grading, and every wharf settlement recomputes the meadow schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 89 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
